Yaar, ek baat kahun? 🥺❤️

Ik he's your crush, aur main kabhi aapse nahi kahunga ki aap unse baat mat karo. Woh aapki choice hai aur main uski respect karunga. Bas jab woh aapke saath the, tab unhone aapki kadar nahi ki, aur ab woh wapas aaye hain, toh agar aapko bhi mere liye thoda sa same feel hota hai na, toh ek baar mujhe chance dekar dekho. 🥹🫂❤️

Main aapko kabhi taken for granted nahi lena chahta, balki bahut pyaar se rakhna, aapka khayal rakhna aur har mushkil mein aapke saath khada rehna chahta hoon. Main chahta hoon ki hum aise hi apne cute-cute moments spend karte rahein, dates par jaayein, saath mein time spend karein aur woh saare moments jeeyein jo humne soche hain. 🥹❤️🧿

Hum har cheez slowly lenge, ek-doosre ko aur achhe se jaanenge aur bina kisi pressure ke apne bond ko grow hone denge. Bas main chahta hoon ki agar aapko bhi humari chemistry aur bond genuinely special lagta hai, toh hum apni feelings ko lekar clarity bhi jaldi paa lein.

Main aapko pressurize nahi karna chahta, bas agar aap bhi mere liye same feel karti ho, toh ek baar humare liye bhi sochna na. Main genuinely aapke saath kuch khoobsurat build karna chahta hoon, aapko khush rakhna chahta hoon aur end tak aapka saath nibhaana chahta hoon. 🫂🥹❤️🧿

Aur please please 🥺🙏, main pakka promise karta hoon ki main self-love bhi karunga, khud ko bhi har din thoda better banata rahunga, taaki main aapke liye aur bhi achha insaan ban sakun. Par aapka dhyaan main khud se bhi zyada rakhunga. 🫂❤️

Aapki choti-choti khushiyon ka khayal rakhunga, aapke bure din pe aapki smile wapas laane ki koshish karunga, aur aapke achhe din ko aur bhi special banaunga. Aap jaisi ho, waise hi mujhe sabse achhi lagti ho, aapko kabhi kisi ke liye khud ko badalna nahi padega. 🧿✨

Bas ek chance, Ojasvi. Main wada karta hoon, aapko kabhi regret nahi hone dunga. 🥹❤️🧿

— Sirf aapka, Aayush ❤️
